limitations: Small hand-authored synthetic fixture, not real-user evaluation or promotion evidence.
Latency samples include network and provider queueing; no production p95 claim.
Cost reservations use conservative character-based token bounds, not actual invoices or provider-side caps.
Gap calibration uses only the calibration split; holdout is reported separately.
No deployed settings or stored vectors are changed.
Fixture deliberately includes near-duplicate negations and only four genuine gap queries; scores are not a representative production accuracy estimate.

recommendation.embedding: Do not make a drop-in Qwen switch. Task-aware Qwen plus the current reranker improved best-match selection from 14/16 to 15/16 and false coverage from 1/4 to 0/4, but added latency. A calibrated BGE cutoff also passed the tiny gap holdout. Larger labeled validation is needed before re-embedding.
recommendation.relevance: Clef is a promising Workers-native reranking candidate for a larger canary, with higher quality on this small stress fixture but higher latency and cost.
recommendation.deployment: No deployed settings, stored vectors or user facts changed.
recommendation.cohere: Excluded under the user constraint to use Workers AI only.
recommendation.combined: Task-aware Qwen plus Clef was the strongest candidate on this smoke fixture (16/16 best matches, 0/4 false coverage), but this is not enough evidence for production replacement.
